shots.name: game_avenue_north
shots.note: An 11 m paved avenue in a 17 m corridor, running north to the outer gate: cobbles up the middle of the frame, two storey-and-a-half eaves either side, roof ridges filling the lower left and right corners. No sky -- a 52 degree camera cannot see above the horizon.

shots.name: game_avenue_east
shots.note: The east avenue seen from inside: a long cobbled slot with jettied timber fronts on both sides, the sunlit right-hand wall carrying the frame, roof tiles along the bottom edge.

shots.name: game_avenue_west
shots.note: The west avenue at dusk-side light: shadowed left wall, warm right wall, the street's own gutter line leading the eye out of frame.

shots.name: game_avenue_south
shots.note: The south avenue toward the harbour: same canyon, but the ground is hollowed by the long shadows the brief asks for, and the far end of the street dissolves into haze.

shots.name: game_street_roof
shots.note: Player at (0,-450) heading 53 degrees north-east into a block corner: roof ridges run diagonally across the middle of the frame, the lane turns out of sight, both eaves are in shot.

shots.name: game_street_1
shots.note: A secondary street 275 m from the centre, 13.0 m wide, with 90 m of clear corridor: two facades close enough to read, roofs at both bottom corners, cobbles between them.

shots.name: game_street_2
shots.note: A secondary street 919 m from the centre, 12.0 m wide, with 90 m of clear corridor: two facades close enough to read, roofs at both bottom corners, cobbles between them.

shots.name: game_street_3
shots.note: A secondary street 841 m from the centre, 13.0 m wide, with 82 m of clear corridor: two facades close enough to read, roofs at both bottom corners, cobbles between them.

shots.name: game_street_4
shots.note: A secondary street 861 m from the centre, 12.0 m wide, with 90 m of clear corridor: two facades close enough to read, roofs at both bottom corners, cobbles between them.

shots.name: eye_avenue_gate
shots.note: Standing on the north avenue 87 m from the gatehouse: two 32 m towers fill the frame, the arch between them is a black slot, the avenue's cobbles run out from under your feet.

shots.name: eye_avenue_south
shots.note: The south avenue looking away from town: houses step down either side, the road narrows into haze, the outer wall crosses the far end.

shots.name: eye_plaza_south
shots.note: The market square from its south-west corner, clear of the misplaced bridge-rib strip at x=0: the fountain's kerb in the middle distance, the market hall's steps and arcade across the far side, the cathedral's south flank closing the left.

shots.name: eye_cathedral_front
shots.note: The cathedral's west front from 39 m back: the three portal bays at eye level, paving running up to them, the rose window above, the gable cut by the top of the frame.  18 mm because 40 m of facade will not fit otherwise.

shots.name: eye_guild_front
shots.note: The guildhall's south front at 17 m: the jettied upper floor overhangs the portal, its windows read as dark rectangles, the eave cuts across the top, its own cobbled forecourt in the foreground.

shots.name: eye_castle_ramp
shots.note: The castle ramp looking up at the gatehouse: the road climbs between retaining walls, the twin towers stand at the top of the rise, the rock face closes everything behind them.

shots.name: eye_street_1
shots.note: A measured street at 408 m from the centre, 40.0 m of clear air ahead at 1.72 m: both facades in the frame, the far end of the street falling away.

shots.name: eye_street_2
shots.note: A measured street at 214 m from the centre, 40.0 m of clear air ahead at 1.72 m: both facades in the frame, the far end of the street falling away.

shots.name: aerial_city
shots.note: The whole town from the south-east at 710 m: the ring wall reads as a circle, the four avenues as spokes, the castle rock and the cathedral spire are the two things that break the roofline.

shots.name: aerial_castle
shots.note: The castle from the north-east: the rock shelf, the curtain, and the keep standing on top of all of it, roofs of the upper town in front.

shots.name: aerial_harbour
shots.note: The harbour: two quays, the bridge with its piers, thirty boats along the water, warehouses at the back.

shots.name: overview_city
shots.note: The establishing frame: the whole capital in one plate, wall and towers on the left, cathedral and town right, the river and the sea haze beyond.

shots.name: landmark_castle_keep
shots.note: The keep from above the gatehouse: the four turrets and the lantern spire at 84.7 m read against the sky, the curtain wall and its towers step down in front, the upper town's roofs below.

shots.name: landmark_cathedral_front
shots.note: The cathedral from the south-east, above the roofs: the transept end, the apse, the 66 m spire over the ridge, the city's slate and terracotta between us and it.

shots.name: landmark_market_hall
shots.note: The market hall from the square: the open arcade at ground level, the great tiled roof above it, the lantern on the ridge, stalls and carts in the foreground.

shots.name: landmark_guild
shots.note: The guildhall three-quarter from the south-west: jettied upper storey, the tall chimney on its east end, the gable end facing the street.

shots.name: landmark_gate_north
shots.note: The north gatehouse from the avenue: twin towers, the arch between them, the curtain wall running away on both sides, roofs of the ring district in front.

shots.name: landmark_gate_south
shots.note: The south gatehouse from the avenue: twin towers, the arch between them, the curtain wall running away on both sides, roofs of the ring district in front.

shots.name: landmark_gate_east
shots.note: The east gatehouse from the avenue: twin towers, the arch between them, the curtain wall running away on both sides, roofs of the ring district in front.

shots.name: landmark_gate_west
shots.note: The west gatehouse from the avenue: twin towers, the arch between them, the curtain wall running away on both sides, roofs of the ring district in front.

shots.name: extra_castle_gate
shots.note: The castle gatehouse with the keep behind it: the gate arch, the two flanking towers, the rock rising straight out of the roofs.

shots.name: extra_castle_keep_air
shots.note: The keep from the city below: the rock rim as a plinth, the gate towers in the middle ground, the keep's lantern spire at 84.7 m behind them.

shots.name: extra_cathedral_west
shots.note: The cathedral's west front from inside its own reserved forecourt, 50 m out and off-axis: both towers' shoulders, the rose window, the portal, and the paving between us and the doors.

shots.name: extra_harbour_bridge
shots.note: The river bridge from the north quay: three arches, the parapet line, boats moored under it, warehouses behind.
